adjust.artist_explain: “Ink” = clean black outline lines (the manga / line-art look) drawn on TOP of the colour fill. Slide left for more paint, right for a bolder outline.
adjust.title: Adjust
advanced.economy: Economy mode (slower, better at low budgets)
app.title: FH6 Paint Studio
editor.left_hint: Drag shapes on the canvas to arrange your livery.
editor.name: Design name
editor.right_hint: Select a shape to move, scale and recolour it. Apply saves your changes back.
editor.title: Shape editor
hint.ai_fast: OFF by default. ON: the engine scores about a quarter of the candidates per shape, guided by a small trained network. Generation is markedly faster and the error is typically 2-6% higher. Turn it on when you want a quick look or you are on a slower graphics card.
hint.alpha:
Allow semi-transparent shapes for smooth gradients. On = smoother organic content; off = fully opaque and crisper. Cutouts stay opaque regardless.

Affects: quality.
hint.alpha_floor:
Lowest opacity a shape may use when semi-transparency is on. Higher = more opaque and crisper; lower = more see-through layering and smoother.

Affects: quality.
hint.artist: How much outline vs paint. Left = more colour fill (alive shading, gradient eyes); right = a bolder ink outline. Set it to match your drawing — manga / line-art wants more line, painted art wants more fill. The shape budget above is split into ink lines + colour fill by this.
hint.aspect:
Maximum elongation for ellipse/rectangle slivers. Higher = thin slivers that trace sharp contours; 0 = round shapes for smooth content. Blank = preset default.

Affects: quality.
hint.backfit:
Remove the weakest shapes and regrow them against the residual before polish. On = better budget use on flat/cutout art, at a small time cost.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.best_of: 1 by default (single run). N>1 reruns the WHOLE generation N times with different random seeds and keeps the best result — run-to-run variance is ~6%, so this squeezes out extra quality at N× the time. Runs are independent (no mixing); the progress bar restarts for each attempt. 2–3 is the sweet spot.
hint.boundary:
Cap each shape by its distance to the nearest edge so shapes can't balloon across contours. On = cleaner flat/logo silhouettes; can fray smooth content.

Affects: quality.
hint.budget: How much detail — the number of shapes to draw (1-3000). Right = finer detail but slower; left = simpler and faster. FH6 allows up to 3000 layers per group (~1000 for a bumper).
hint.compact:
Bias the per-shape pick toward compact shapes, especially the first few, for a cleaner coarse base.

Affects: quality.
hint.crop_active: working on a crop — Generate rebuilds just this at the full budget
hint.crop_detail: crop a detail (a face, a logo) to spend the whole budget on it
hint.crop_editing: drag to select · handles to resize · inside to move
hint.economy: OFF by default. At low shape counts (≲1500) this co-adapts the shapes — it keeps re-fitting ALL of them together as it builds, for a cleaner result with fewer shapes. The catch: it's MUCH slower (it re-polishes the whole set repeatedly), so turn it on only when you want maximum quality on a tight budget and don't mind the wait. No effect on Logo/Flat or above ~1500 shapes.
hint.edge_softness:
Softness of the polished edges. Lower = crisper, harder edges; higher = softer, smoother blends.

Affects: quality.
hint.edge_weight_strength:
How strongly the edge map biases shape placement. Higher = more edge-focused detail; 0 = uniform.

Affects: quality.
hint.edge_weighting:
Focus the error on salient edges instead of weighting every pixel equally. On = sharper contours; off = uniform.

Affects: quality.
hint.expert_disclaimer: Advanced controls, as-is. Every one can change render time and quality, in either direction — the preset above already picks good values, so only touch these if you know what you want. While this is open, these values are used; collapse it to fall back to the preset's tuned defaults.
hint.fh6_template: The number of LAYERS in the in-game vinyl group you're injecting into — it must match. If it's smaller than the generation's shapes, the extra shapes are silently dropped in-game. Make a group with enough layers in FH6 first, then put that count here.
hint.gaussian: Soft-glow mode trains glow splats jointly — no greedy options apply. Detail = number of glows; more glows + the automatic training give a closer (but always smooth) result. Best for SMOOTH / gradient / painterly images — it can't render crisp fine detail, so use Drawing/Photo/Logo for sharp or cel content. Slower than the others (it trains; the bar shows training progress).
hint.grid:
Backend error-grid resolution for candidate sampling. Blank = 48. Mostly a performance knob.

Affects: time.
hint.keep_inside: ON by default. Generates against a transparent surround so the spill penalty forces every shape to stay INSIDE the picture, with no circles or rectangles ballooning past the edge (the worst in-game artefact). The reconstruction is mapped back to the original size afterwards, so the preview is clean. Turn off only for the legacy behaviour.
hint.kind_weights:
Relative pick weight per selected kind (higher = picked more often). Leave blank for an even mix.

Affects: quality.
hint.max_no_improve:
Consecutive non-improving shapes before the greedy stops early. Higher = fills more of the budget. Blank = preset default.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.mono: For a FLAT single-colour brand logo or decal. Forces every shape to ONE solid colour (auto-detected from the logo) on a clean cutout, so there are no grey antialiased-edge shapes and no background box — just the crisp single-colour silhouette. Pairs with a low shape budget. Leave OFF for normal multi-colour images.
hint.mutated:
Hill-climb mutations of the best candidate per step. More = finer local refinement but slower. Blank = preset count.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.no_eagle: OFF by default. The contour polish term sharpens where the target has real structure. Measured over 16 pictures it helps on about half and hurts on the rest, by up to 3% either way, so there is no right default — turn it off and compare if outlines look over-drawn.
hint.no_false_edge: OFF by default. The false-edge term punishes edges the reconstruction invents that the source does not have. Same measurement: helps on about half the pictures, hurts on the rest. Turn it off if the result looks too soft.
hint.open_subtitle: turn any photo or drawing into FH6 vinyl shapes
hint.overdraw:
Generate this multiple of the budget, then prune back to it. Above 1 trades time for a slightly better final set. Blank = off.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.pixel: Pixel-art mode reproduces the art EXACTLY — it detects the pixel grid and rebuilds every color region from solid rectangles, pixel-perfect. No engine settings apply: the art itself defines the shape count (a 32×32 sprite is typically 100–300 shapes). If the art needs more than 3000 rectangles, generation stops with the required count — crop to one sprite or simplify the palette. Works best with clean PNG exports (no smoothing/JPEG).
hint.polish:
Refines all shapes together after the greedy build. On = smoother, better colour fit; off = faster but rawer and more faceted.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.polish_iters:
How many polish refinement steps. More = closer fit and smoother gradients but slower; early-stop trims the tail. Blank = the preset's tuned count. For flat art the tuned count depends on the palette.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.preset_name: Save the current settings, including budget and seed, as a reusable preset. It appears under the built-in presets in the dropdown above.
hint.quality:
Search depth: how many shape candidates are scored per step. Higher (max/quality/ultra) = better placement but much slower; lower (fast/balanced) = quicker and rougher.

Affects: time most, then quality.
hint.random:
Random candidate shapes generated per step. More = a better search but slower. Blank = the quality preset's count.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.ready: Pick a style on the left and hit Generate.
hint.ready_no_image: Open an image, pick a style, then Generate.
hint.sample:
Pixels scored per candidate (progressive sampling). Higher = more accurate scoring but slower. Blank = backend default.

Affects: time and quality.
hint.seed: Random seed. The same image, settings, and seed always give an identical result. Change it for a different variation.
hint.source_res: OFF by default — large images are fitted at a fast working resolution. ON: the engine fits at the image's ORIGINAL resolution, so fine lines and small detail survive on big sources. Generation can take several times longer; use it when you want maximum quality. No effect on images at or below the working size.
hint.standout:
Post-polish pass that recolours or removes shapes drawing an edge the target lacks (a visible circle or square). The value is the allowed global-error rise; 0 = off. Judge by eye.

Affects: quality.
hint.used_shapes:
Which primitive shapes the generator may use. All on by default; turning some off makes the result coarser but faster. At least one stays on.

Affects: time and quality.
inject.guide_step1: In FH6, add a vinyl group with at least as many layers as the generation's shapes.
inject.guide_step2: Set “FH6 template” (top-right) to that group's layer count.
inject.guide_step3: Click Inject on the generation — the app needs admin + FH6 running.
inject.guide_step4: In FH6, Save & reload the vinyl — the mesh only appears after a reload.
